origin.description: Estimate mutual information between X and Y.
origin.details: direct TRUE uses the max-norm count. direct FALSE subtracts the joint entropy from the two marginal entropies and returns a vector of length k.
origin.example: mutinfo of 1:10 and (1:10)^2, k=3, direct TRUE and direct FALSE

translation.description: direct TRUE counts max-norm neighbors. direct FALSE is the sum of the two entropies minus the joint entropy.
translation.details: direct TRUE uses the max-norm count. direct FALSE subtracts the joint entropy from the two marginal entropies and returns a vector of length k.
